correctness.rationale: For every 0<s<1, the regression polynomial for E[X2²X3² | X1=x] is v2v3+2r²+(a²v3+b²v2+4abr)x²+a²b²x⁴ with v2=1-a²,v3=1-b²,r=c-ab. Gaussian negative-moment ratios are 1-s and (1-s)(3-s), giving normalized signed difference exactly -s[a²+b²+4abc-(2+s)a²b²]. For q=|ab|, the positive-semidefinite elliptope condition and AM-GM imply F>=-2q+(6-s)q²>=-1/(6-s), with equality iff |a|=|b|=sqrt(1/(6-s)), c=sgn(ab)(2/(6-s)-1), a rank-2 boundary correlation. Equality gives s/(6-s); positive definite matrices approximate but do not attain. Direct symbolic algebra independently rederived the conditional identity and extremum; s=1/2 gives 1/11. No infinite conclusion was inferred from finite grids.
